 10 Most Popular Products Our Readers Are Shopping on Sale for Black Friday 
 Follow Home & Outdoor Products View feed 10 Most Popular Products Our Readers Are Shopping on Sale for Black Friday 
 Get up to 50% off products from popular brands like Shark, Levi’s, Ninja, and Brooklinen!
 By Isabella Cavallo Published: Nov 19, 2026 8:32 AM EST Save Article Share Article We've been independently researching and testing products for over 120 years. If you buy through our links, we may earn a commission. Learn more about our review process. 
 In the Readers' Faves edition of What's In My Cart , we reveal the top products our readers can't stop buying right now, selected from our editors' latest gift recs , trending new launches, and the best products tested by Good Housekeeping Institute experts. 
 At the end of each month, I round up the products that were a hit among our readers. Many of the most popular items our readers shopped in November are on crazy sale right now, so I compiled my list a little earlier than usual.
 I found plenty of deals on our readers’ favorites from early November, including vintage-inspired holiday cards, toys, stylish apparel, and top-tested bedding and vacuums. Some of the top-performing products from our Good Housekeeping Institute are even up to 50% off already, including a Shark vacuum and a Brooklinen sheet set.
 Best Deal Shark Stratos Upright Vacuum $530 $265 NOW 50% OFF JUMP TO REVIEW 1 Brooklinen Luxe Core Sheet Set
 1 Brooklinen Luxe Core Sheet Set
 Now 25% Off $209 $157 Brooklinen This past month, thousands of our readers shopped the Brooklinen Luxe Core Sheet Set, which was the top-performing sateen set of sheets we tested in the Textiles Lab. Soft, comfortable, and smooth, these durable sheets have a shiny appearance yet still feel crisp. They’re always worth the money, but luckily for everyone, Brooklinen’s Black Friday sale started early with a 25% off sitewide discount happening right now.
 RELATED: Brooklinen's Black Friday Sale Already Started—Get 40% Off Top-Tested Sheets and Bedding 
 2 Best overall air fryer Air Fryer Pro XL
 2 Best overall air fryer Air Fryer Pro XL
 Now 28% Off $180 $130 Amazon Our pros in the Kitchen & Cooking Lab have tested over 70 air fryers in the past nine years, and the Ninja Air Fryer Pro XL is our best overall pick. In our tests, this air fryer made crispy wings, and we were impressed by its wide basket. Plus, the intuitive controls make it easy to whip up a quick dinner or snack.
 RELATED: After Testing 70+ Models, These Are the Best Air Fryers 
 Advertisement - Continue Reading Below 3 Popular jeans Levi’s Ribcage Flare Jeans
 3 Popular jeans Levi’s Ribcage Flare Jeans
 Now 40% Off $110 $66 LEVI'S Credit: Levi's For some reason, the one thing I always buy on Black Friday is a new pair of jeans. My jeans always stretch out over time, and I’m always picking the wrong size, but the Levi’s Ribcage Flare Jeans lasted me for years (I only donated them after I needed a new size up!). These high-waisted jeans have a subtle flare that styles well with heels and boots, and they’re available in five washes. Plus, we love Levi’s extensive size range.
 4 best overall vacuum Shark Stratos Upright Vacuum
 4 best overall vacuum Shark Stratos Upright Vacuum
 Now 50% Off $530 $265 Amazon This upright vacuum is powerful, compatible with all floor types, and was rated the best overall vacuum by our Cleaning Lab pros. “I found it was easy to use, and it demonstrated great cleaning ability across a wide range of flooring types, making it a great fit for most households,” said Noah Pinsonnault , a product analyst in the Cleaning Lab. It’s 50% off right now, along with tons of other Shark vacuums on sale for Black Friday .
 READ OUR FULL REVIEW: Shark's Stratos Upright Vacuum Cleaner 
 Advertisement - Continue Reading Below 5 Classic Christmas Decor Plow & Earth Indoor/Outdoor Blue Ridge Wreath
 5 Classic Christmas Decor Plow & Earth Indoor/Outdoor Blue Ridge Wreath
 Now 20% Off $150 $120 Plow & Earth Credit: Plow & Earth ‘Tis the season, and our readers are shopping for holiday decorations left and right. Many of them are loving classic, traditional decor like garlands and wreaths. Decorated with holly berries and pinecones, this small wreath is pre-strung with battery-operated lights to make decorating simple. Hang it outside on your front door or above a fireplace indoors.
 6 vintage holiday cards Minted Vintage Lace (100 Pack)
 6 vintage holiday cards Minted Vintage Lace (100 Pack)
 Now 20% Off $192 $154 Minted Credit: Minted Along with shopping for decor, our readers are also picking their holiday cards for the year. It’s not too late to customize and mail cards with the brand Minted, which sells adorable vintage-inspired holiday photo cards. Simply pick a template, upload a picture of you and your family, and customize the words, shapes, and colors. Then, use code EARLYBIRD26 for 20% off your order.
 Advertisement - Continue Reading Below 7 Ages 8+ Butt Face Chester Cheeks Toy
 7 Ages 8+ Butt Face Chester Cheeks Toy
 Now 33% Off $30 $20 Amazon One of the most (if not the most) popular toys our readers have been shopping for is this crazy butt-faced toy. Nicknamed Chester Cheeks, this silly toy regularly sells out, so it’s best to snag it while it’s in stock and on sale ahead of Black Friday. It makes an assortment of farting noises when you squeeze or spread his cheeks, and he dances when you press his head. Kids will go bonkers opening this hilarious holiday gift.
 8 best overall sewing machine Brother XR9550 Sewing and Quilting Machine
 8 best overall sewing machine Brother XR9550 Sewing and Quilting Machine
 Now 15% Off $270 $230 Amazon Whether your child is a fashionista or someone you know starts a new hobby every other month (guilty!), a sewing machine makes for a great gift. This is our sewing experts’ pick for the best overall sewing machine , and it’s what I used to learn how to sew. The buttons are intuitive, the thread is easy to set up, and the speed control helped me begin sewing at a steady, slow pace.
 READ OUR FULL REVIEW: I'm Learning How to Sew On Our Highest-Rated Sewing Machine. Here's How It's Going .
 Advertisement - Continue Reading Below 9 Rothy's The Square Mary Jane
 9 Rothy's The Square Mary Jane
 Now 44% Off $159 $89 Amazon We have some stylish readers, and they’ve been shopping this sale for one of my favorite winter flats. I own this pair of knitted Mary Jane flats in red, and they style well with jeans or a skirt and tights. The cushioned sole makes them comfortable to walk around in, so I regularly wear them on my commute to the office in New York City. My shoes are red, which works well with holiday party outfits, but I also love this more neutral colorway with a black toe cap that looks oh-so chic.
 READ OUR FULL REVIEW: My Honest Review of Rothy's Flats 
 10 best value electric blanke Beautyrest Heated Throw
 10 best value electric blanke Beautyrest Heated Throw
 $104 Amazon Now that the weather is getting chillier, our readers are shopping for some heated blankets to keep them warm. We love this budget-friendly pick that has more than 20 adjustable temperature settings and a one-hour preheating option. In our evaluations in the Textiles Lab, this blanket heated up quickly and distributed the warmth evenly. Our consumer testers appreciated the soft fabric and how easy it was to operate. .
